answer: Inter-arrival floor with decay. Each identity must keep a minimum gap between its own outbound messages, and that floor rises toward a summit as recent activity accelerates, so bursts widen the next required silence. Traffic shape becomes the credential: steady pacing is cheap, parallelism is not. A clone army must either stagger agents across real time, multiplying latency per unit of output, or pay a marble-like fixed compute delay per message. Forged identities also accrue a pigment of history debt: new keys start at the strictest gap, and only sustained correct pacing relaxes it.
